length_m.note: the table's extended-range 4,490 mm taken as the infrared R-27ET's, plus the radar seeker's extra length (the R-27R's 4.08 m less the R-27T's 3.795): 4.78 m

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

explosive_kg.note: a game reference: War Thunder's su_r_27er (TGAF-5); no manufacturer or encyclopedia gives the charge

gurney_kms.note: TGAF-5 (TNT/RDX/aluminium, Russian) is not in Cooper's table: as HBX, its nearest composition - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.00707, its base 0.00270, its fins' friction 0.00631 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 0.2197 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.982 for its fineness 18.4 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
